node22_public.findings: exit may precede stdio close; killed is not terminal; signal/send errors and exit need separate bounded settlement

node22_windows_uv.findings: uv_process_kill uses recorded process_handle; uv_kill(pid) reopens by PID; endgame closes process handle

node24_parent_windows_uv.findings: same recorded-handle API pattern examined; do not use private JavaScript _handle

electron44_utility.findings: Kill opens process via pid_; not an exposed whole-tree Job capability

windows_identity.findings: handle remains valid until closed; process ID lifecycle differs; retain opaque original handle

windows_times.findings: GetProcessTimes returns creation FILETIME for same process handle

windows_jobs.findings: scope Job explicitly; nested Jobs Windows8+; control breakaway and handle inheritance

windows_job_assign.findings: assign uses real process handle; binding failure must fail closed before Core business starts

windows_job_terminate.findings: terminate by owned Job HANDLE and observe actual process-count convergence

taskkill.findings: numeric /PID and /T act on selected parent and its children, no supplied FILETIME capability

node_api.findings: use only stable Node-API, pin supported NAPI_VERSION and verify both Node22/Electron24 loaders; avoid V8/libuv private ABI
